roles.detailed: Backend Engineer · Full-Stack Developer · System Design

bio: .NET Full-Stack Engineer with 2+ years building production-grade APIs and SPAs at Ericsson and SassGrow. Strong backend in C# / ASP.NET Core 8 / EF Core / MS SQL Server with Clean Architecture, CQRS, and SOLID; frontend in Angular + TypeScript. Hands-on with Docker, Azure, and CI/CD — focused on measurable latency, reliability, and release-velocity gains in Agile sprints.

bullets: Architected a multi-tenant ASP.NET Core 8 REST API with strict per-tenant data isolation; onboarded enterprise clients via zero-downtime blue-green deployments on Azure App Service.

Delivered Angular + TypeScript dashboards with lazy-loaded feature modules, RxJS state, Reactive Forms, and JWT-secured routes — standardized UX across modules and improved perceived load performance.
Tuned EF Core schemas with composite/covering indexes, stored procedures, and Azure Cache for Redis on hot endpoints — held reporting-API p95 latency under 150 ms and cut DB round-trips ~60%.

Modernized release engineering with multi-stage Dockerfiles and Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines (build → test → staging → prod gates) — cut deployment time from ~45 min to under 15 min and eliminated manual release errors.
experience.desc: Multi-tenant SaaS platform with ASP.NET Core 8, Angular dashboards, EF Core optimization, and Azure CI/CD. Enterprise-grade performance and security.

bullets: Designed a Network Configuration Management API in ASP.NET Core that retired a legacy monolith and provisioned 200+ live network nodes for internal OSS tooling — cut average provisioning time ~35% for the NOC team.

Re-engineered a real-time alarm aggregation service into an event-driven pipeline using async/await and Azure Service Bus — drove alert-to-dashboard latency from ~3 s to under 500 ms under peak event load.
Migrated a legacy .NET Framework 4.8 → .NET Core 8 — shrunk memory footprint ~35% and unlocked Linux-based deployment, lowering monthly compute cost.

Designed the network performance datastore in MS SQL Server using EF Core migrations, composite indexing, table partitioning, and tuned stored procedures — sustained 10,000+ writes/min with sub-second reads at scale.
experience.desc: Network Configuration Management API, event-driven alarm aggregation, legacy .NET migration, high-performance datastore design sustaining 10,000+ writes/min.

bullets: Built Java data mediation adapters for the Ericsson Intelligent Integrated Mediation Platform (EIIMP), normalizing 5G RAN event streams into the central OSS data layer.
Developed JUnit test suites that surfaced 3 production-blocking defects pre-release, improving code quality and reliability.
Worked on concurrent programming patterns and REST API design for handling high-volume event streams.
experience.desc: Java data mediation adapters for 5G RAN event stream normalization. Concurrent programming and REST API design with comprehensive test coverage.
